title: SpaceX IPO后闪电收购Cursor 600亿美元全权益资产交易
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: But let's start with the cursor deal if we may, so we knew that this could happen because they have the right to acquire cursor as stated in April.
segments.zh: 先说说Cursor交易吧，我们早知道可能发生，因为4月就规定他们有权收购Cursor。

segments.en: But they've moved very quickly since the IPO on Thursday Friday.
segments.zh: 但IPO后周四、周五他们就迅速行动了。

segments.en: What is it that you think SpaceX gets with cursor? What do you think they intend to do?
segments.zh: 你觉得SpaceX从Cursor得到什么？他们打算做什么？

segments.en: Yeah, you know, the company has been very clear that they want to have a role in the AI space and that they want to be one of the competitors within that space.
segments.zh: 公司明确表示想在AI领域占有一席之地，成为竞争者之一。

segments.en: And so with Groc, they have the opportunity here and now with the cursor team as you were just talking about earlier, they acquire a team here that they can ultimately come in and potentially give them a chance with the competitors in the space.
segments.zh: 通过Groc，他们有机会，现在有了Cursor团队，最终可能让他们与竞争对手一较高下。

segments.en: So I think it's brilliant. You have the successful IPO and the ability to come in and do the steal right on day three now.
segments.zh: 我觉得很聪明，IPO成功，第三天就能完成收购。

segments.en: Pretty big aqua higher. Pretty big aqua higher.
segments.zh: 相当大规模的收购人才。

segments.en: I mean, the mechanics of that I find really interesting because SpaceX's valuation actually is valuation today relative to Friday.
segments.zh: 我觉得机制很有趣，SpaceX的估值相比周五有优势，全权益资产交易。

segments.en: It's a bit of an advantage right in an all stock deal. How do you feel about it? You know, the mechanism, a $60 billion deal right now in how that impacts the stock as an existing investor?
segments.zh: 600亿美元的交易，对现有市场参与者权益资产有何影响？

segments.en: Yeah, look, we were already, we knew this was going to come, right?
And so the fact that it's coming now it makes sense with the fact that this IPO was very successful.
segments.zh: 现在上市时机合理，这次IPO非常成功。

segments.en: I mean, they've done a fantastic job. The bankers, your Goldman Morgan Stanley did a great job bringing this to the public markets.
segments.zh: 他们做得非常出色，高盛和摩根士丹利成功将公司推向公开市场。
